lines: If the power grid fails tonight, do not panic and follow these vital survival rules.
The city lights suddenly die across the entire skyline, plunging millions into total darkness.
Marcus stands on the downtown sidewalk as panic spreads quickly through the massive crowd.
He remembers the rules and knows he must act fast before the danger grows worse.
One. Store water early by filling every container and the bathtub while taps still work.
Marcus moves quickly to complete this urgent task in his small apartment before pressure drops.
Two. Keep the fridge and freezer closed to preserve your food supply safely.
A closed fridge keeps food safe about 4 hours, and a full freezer about 48 hours.
Three. Use flashlights, not candles, because candles cause devastating house fires during blackouts.
Marcus grabs his trusty flashlight and checks the batteries to ensure they work properly.
He never runs a generator, grill, or camp stove indoors because carbon monoxide kills silently.
Now Marcus walks to shelter at the tall office building to find a safe location.
The streets are pitch black and navigating without light becomes extremely dangerous for everyone.
Marcus reaches the heavy glass doors of the towering office building and steps inside.
It was the absolute safest plan for surviving the catastrophic night of darkness.
There was just one problem when the heavy security doors locked automatically from behind him.
part1.cliffhanger: The heavy security doors lock automatically behind Marcus, trapping him inside with an unknown threat.

lines: Twelve boys and their young coach walk into a dark cave and vanish without a single trace.
On 23 June 2018, sudden heavy rain floods every single exit and traps them deep inside.
Days pass in total darkness while water rises and families wait anxiously outside the flooded gates.
On 2 July, two British divers finally find the starving group sitting silently on a rock shelf.
They are located about two kilometers from the entrance with no way to swim out alone.
Rescuers make a desperate plan to give each boy a full-face mask and heavy sedatives.
Experienced divers guide the unconscious children one by one through narrow and completely flooded underground tunnels.
Between 8 July and 10 July, this risky underwater operation brings every single trapped person out.
Around 10,000 people work together to pull off this impossible rescue against all odds.
Former Thai Navy SEAL Saman Kunan makes the ultimate sacrifice and loses his life during operations.
Another brave SEAL named Beirut Pakbara also dies in 2019 from an infection caught down there.
This massive team effort saves every trapped child and their coach from the flooded caves.
Human courage pushes past extreme limits to bring the Wild Boars football team back home.
How would you stay brave in total darkness for ten days while waiting for rescue?
draft_evening.title: The Impossible Thai Cave Rescue That Shocked The Entire World
draft_evening.description: How 12 boys and their coach survived deep inside a flooded cave in 2018.
